correctness.rationale: Direct five-stage algebra gives the exact rational factor times p. Since p is strictly decreasing for nonnegative arguments, its unique zero and the rational zero fully characterize sign changes. A coincident-zero resonance is necessary and sufficient for no negative interval. Monotone factors prove all interval bounds and the unique post-zero unit crossing. Exact-rational checker and decimal bisection reproduce calculations without replacing proof.

value.rationale: A positivity-controlled integrator must distinguish nonnegative damping from spectral boundedness. The exact unique implicitness fraction and discontinuous sharp safe-step jump (from 3.596... near it to 7.450... exactly at it) quantify a nonrobust design boundary for the published mixed RK time integrator. This is a natural invariant of a specified method, not an arbitrary parameter slice; no PDE stability claim is made.
